info.title: MedLens API
info.description:
MedLens checks a photo of a medicine pack against the register of NAFDAC-approved products and
returns a verdict with a confidence value:

* `LIKELY_GENUINE`: the pack matches a registered product and no risk signal fired.
* `SUSPICIOUS`: one or more risk signals fired, for example an expired registration, a batch
  seen in too many places, or a pack that does not look like the genuine reference.
* `UNREGISTERED`: no registered product matches the NAFDAC number on the pack.
* `INCONCLUSIVE`: the photo could not be read reliably; retake it in good light.

**A verdict is a risk assessment, never a guarantee that a medicine is genuine or safe to use.**
A `LIKELY_GENUINE` result only means no problem was detected. Suspected counterfeits should be
reported to NAFDAC; clients must present results with that caveat.

Conventions:

* Errors use [RFC 9457](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457) `application/problem+json` with
  a stable `type` URI (`urn:medlens:problem:<slug>`) and a `request_id`.
* Send `X-Request-ID` (a UUID) to correlate requests; it is echoed on every response.
* Lists are cursor-paginated: pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`.

get.description: Returns 200 while the process can serve HTTP. It touches no dependency, so an outage in Postgres, Redis or S3 never makes the orchestrator restart healthy API processes.

Probes Postgres, Redis and object storage concurrently, each with a short timeout (`MEDLENS_APP__READINESS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`), and reports a status per dependency. Returns 200 when all are reachable, and also when only Redis is down (`degraded`): the API has fallbacks for Redis, and every instance shares it, so removing them all from the load balancer would only turn a partial outage into a full one. Returns 503 when Postgres or object storage is unavailable; load balancers should then stop routing traffic to the instance.

503.description: Postgres or object storage is unavailable.

post.summary: Submit a pack photo for verification
post.description:
Multipart form: `image` (JPEG, PNG or WebP) and optionally `latitude`/`longitude`, `state` and the `nafdac_number` printed on the pack. Open to guests, who must send `X-Device-Id`. Returns 202 with the scan id; poll `status_url` for the verdict.

Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to retry safely: the same key and request replay the first response; the same key with a different request is a 409. The same photo from the same person or device within 24 hours returns the earlier scan with 200 and `duplicate: true`. With the sync fast path on (`MEDLENS_QUEUE__SYNC_WAIT_SECONDS`) and a short queue, the request may wait a few seconds and answer 200 with `result`. When the queue is very long it answers 503 with Retry-After.

Privacy: the photo is re-encoded (metadata removed) before storage; coordinates are rounded to about 1 km and never stored raw.
